props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: bounces
props.description: Whether the textarea scroll-view should bounce at its edges (iOS).

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the textarea.

props.name: inputFilter
props.description:
Regex string filter applied by the native input before the value is
surfaced to JS.

props.name: lineSpacing
props.description: Spacing between lines in px / lynx-units. Forwarded to the native node.

props.name: maxLength
props.description:
Maximum number of characters allowed. Defaults to `140` per the Lynx
default.

props.name: maxLines
props.description:
Maximum number of visible lines before scrolling kicks in. Defaults to
`40` to match the React port.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Whether the textarea renders as read-only.

props.name: showSoftInputOnFocus
props.description: When `false`, focus will not raise the software keyboard.

events.name: input
events.type: [value: string, selectionStart: number, selectionEnd: number, isComposing: boolean]

events.name: keyboard
events.type: [info: { visible: boolean; height: number; safeAreaBottom: number; }]
